name: Harnack Tracing
definition: A method for visualizing surfaces encoded by harmonic functions (including angle-valued functions and those with singularities) by using conservative Harnack bounds on the growth of harmonic functions to determine step sizes, avoiding numerical issues common to generic root finding methods.
summary: Harnack tracing efficiently finds zero-crossings in harmonic functions by using conservative growth bounds to determine step sizes, avoiding numerical issues common to generic root finding.
